name: Backend Required Quality Gates

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  backend:
    name: Backend Quality Gate
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'backend') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'api')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

  backend-noop:
    name: Backend No-Op
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && !(contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'backend') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'api')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "No backend changes – passing no-op."

  security:
    name: Security Gate
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'security') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'bandit')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  security-noop:
    name: Security No-Op
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && !(contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'security') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'bandit')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "No security changes – passing no-op."

  frontend:
    name: Frontend Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test -- --coverage

  e2e:
    name: E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-e2e tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e

  coverage:
    name: Coverage Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=tldw_Server_API --cov-report=xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.xml
      - uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml

  dependency-review:
    name: Dependency Review
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/dependency-review@f0e1d2c3b4a5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1
